radiant.alt: An orange-lit corner shop on a dark street, with pipes, signs and a vending machine around its windows.
radiant.description: A small shop spills amber light onto a quiet street. Pipes, signs and darkened windows surround its warm interior, making one illuminated corner feel like a refuge from the night.

tea_time.alt: A warmly lit room with a green door, shelves of jars, and a small table set with a cup and plate.
tea_time.description: A cup waits on a small table beneath the warm light of a crowded room. Shelves, jars and a well-worn green door turn an everyday tea break into a scene full of small discoveries.

moon_shine.alt: A moon hangs above a teal city canyon crowded with buildings, balconies, cables and air-conditioning units.
moon_shine.description: Moonlight settles over a narrow canyon of buildings, cables and balconies. The cool teal palette brings stillness to the city's dense geometry, inviting the eye to wander from one rooftop to the next.

rainbow.alt: A narrow kitchen filled with bottles, dishes and a small table, lit in turquoise, pink and violet.
rainbow.description: Pink, violet and turquoise light transform a narrow kitchen into a little world of colour. Bottles, dishes and everyday clutter catch the glow, giving familiar objects an unexpected theatrical presence.

copper.alt: A restaurant interior in copper and amber tones, with shelves of bottles, a counter, tiled walls and ceiling ducts.
copper.description: Copper and amber tones gather around a restaurant counter. Bottles, tiled surfaces and overhead ducts give the room a practical, lived-in character, while the warm light makes its empty spaces feel welcoming.

milk_tea.alt: A sunlit milk-tea storefront with a pink awning, Chinese lettering, climbing greenery and air-conditioning units.
milk_tea.description: A pink awning and milk-tea sign brighten a sunlit storefront. Greenery softens the walls and air-conditioning units, bringing a small pocket of freshness to the tightly packed street.

hearth.alt: A glowing red-orange shop tucked into a dense stack of dark buildings, pipes, signs and outdoor units.
hearth.description: A red-orange shop glows within a dense stack of buildings and machinery. Against the cool surrounding city, its bright window becomes a small hearth: an inviting centre of warmth in an intricate urban scene.

night_sky.alt: Illuminated shops and projecting signs line a quiet street beneath dark blue sky and clouds.
night_sky.description: Bright signs and open shopfronts punctuate a dark street beneath a wide night sky. The contrast between the busy architecture and the quiet clouds gives the scene room to breathe.

last_morning.alt: A narrow blue kitchen with fluorescent lights, stools, shelves, and a red glow along one wall.
last_morning.description: Cool blue light fills a narrow kitchen, interrupted by a red glow along the wall. Stools, shelves and suspended fluorescent tubes make the empty room feel suspended between the end of a night and the start of a day.

shimmer.alt: A golden sunlit room crowded with framed pictures, shelves, plants and a glowing old television.
shimmer.description: Sunlight makes an ordinary room feel strangely dreamlike. The publisher's note describes a place that is recognisable yet unfamiliar, and the wish to linger rather than wake.

second_chance.alt: A dim kitchen with bottles, a washing machine, a small green sprout by the sink, and a view into a pink-lit room.
second_chance.description: The publisher's note connects a newly planted sprout with the uncertainty of caring for something fragile. Growth needs patience and a chance to begin, even when survival cannot be guaranteed.

still_night.alt: A green-blue kitchen and sitting room at night, with a sink, bottles, framed pictures and a lit window.
still_night.description: Green and blue light settles across a kitchen and the room beyond. Framed pictures, a sink and a table remain quietly in place, turning an unoccupied interior into a portrait of domestic stillness.

through_dust.alt: A dim, cluttered sitting room with framed pictures, a sofa, plants and an open doorway admitting daylight.
through_dust.description: Daylight enters a shadowed room filled with pictures, plants and worn furniture. The open doorway draws the eye outward, while the collected objects inside suggest the slow accumulation of ordinary life.

purple_fatigue.alt: An outdoor urban seating area with stools, small tables and layered signs, coloured in purple, blue and red.
purple_fatigue.description: Purple and blue shadows settle around an outdoor cluster of stools and tables. Layered signs and red accents keep the city visually busy, even as the empty seating suggests a moment of rest.

breeze.alt: A sunlit alley with overhead cables, hanging greenery, scattered papers and a red vending machine.
breeze.description: Sunlight cuts through a narrow alley of wires, signs and hanging greenery. Scattered papers and a red vending machine give the scene small points of movement and colour beneath the open blue sky.

0542.alt: A red-lit building and rooftop structures rise above a blue city street beneath a violet early-morning sky.
0542.description: Red signs and rooftop structures stand against a violet-blue sky. The title fixes the scene at a precise early hour, while the contrasting lights hold the city between the atmosphere of night and the arrival of morning.
